project: Wuxia Life P21 Content Production And Tuning Closure
description: Complete a productionization pass for wuxia content authoring and tuning by auditing the current authoring surfaces, defining explicit workflow and quality rules, refining profile-first content and constraint surfaces for safer LLM participation, proving the workflow with representative production and tuning samples, and closing the phase with validation evidence without adding UI work, new themes, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit current content authoring surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of the current wuxia content authoring surfaces so that P21 targets the real production bottlenecks first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current authoring surfaces for events, callbacks, summaries, route weighting, stage pacing, legacy or endgame content, and replayability tuning
Mark each surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit workflow pain points and hidden coupling
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the main content workflow pain points documented so that P21 fixes the most expensive authoring friction instead of adding broad new process.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the current pain points for adding or tuning wuxia content across authoring, validation, and regression checking
Identify which pain points come from hidden field semantics, runtime knowledge, or missing reports
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write content addition workflow rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for adding wuxia content so that future content work follows one coherent production model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the expected workflow for adding new wuxia content from authoring through validation
Define the minimum required artifacts or reports for content additions
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write tuning and validation workflow rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for tuning wuxia content so that weight or distribution changes are made through a stable loop instead of ad hoc patching.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the expected workflow for tuning weights, distribution, or pacing inputs
Define how tuning changes are validated through reports, samples, or gate evidence
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write quality and recurrence guardrails
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for wuxia quality, thematic recurrence, and slop boundaries so that future content work stays recognizable and intentional.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what counts as acceptable thematic recurrence versus harmful repetition or slop
Define the minimum expectations for route fit, stage fit, tone consistency, and wuxia flavor
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write config-only and deferred-scope boundaries
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit boundaries for config-only work versus runtime work so that P21 does not quietly expand into a broad engine rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which content changes are safe through config or content files alone
Define which changes require minimal runtime support
Define which production or tuning problems are explicitly deferred beyond P21
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/
